summary: Cross-service smoke coverage for multi-event admission flows

comments.body:
<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=summary -->
Spawned by TKT-73 / ADR-025 (admission lifecycle events and offline reconciliation). The ADR's decision statements are binding constraints on this ticket.

<!-- sdlc:stage=backlog kind=readiness -->
Shaping pass. Verdict: READY — test-only ticket (source changes out of scope; a bug surfaced by a new smoke test gets reported, not fixed in-line, per the test-scope rule). Scope refreshed to include TKT-87's pass flows, which post-date the ticket's creation. risk:low plausible but NOT suggested: the suite is gate-load-bearing and cross-service.

description: Extend the gateway smoke suite beyond per-ticket TDD: replayed scans (same occurrence id), concurrent duplicates, offline out-of-order reconciliation, one redeemed + N duplicate_admit, N-event chains passing verify-lifecycle with RequireCoverage. Complements — does not replace — the TDD each implementation ticket owes (ADR-025 follow-up; seams: smoke/checkout_test.go, migration_smoke_test.go).

objective.note: Per-ticket TDD proves store semantics; nothing proves the admission flows end-to-end across gateway/catalog/commerce/access on one running stack.

scope.note: IN: gateway smoke additions — replayed scans (same occurrence id), concurrent duplicates, offline out-of-order reconciliation, one redeemed + N duplicate_admit, N-event chains under verify-lifecycle RequireCoverage; NOW ALSO the TKT-87 pass flows (entry/exit/direction, derived-conflict raise->withdraw) which post-date this ticket's creation. OUT: load/perf profiles (onsale-load owns those), scanner UI.

uncertainties.note: Which scenarios need new fixtures vs extending smoke/checkout_test.go's existing issuance path — Planning reads the suite. Time-window fixtures must be relative to now (TKT-93 learning).

dependencies.note: TKT-84/85/87 all merged — every event type and path under test exists. No open blockers.

approach.note: Extend the gateway smoke suite (smoke/*.go) driving the real compose stack through /api/access endpoints; assert trail + verify-lifecycle + alarm outbox effects.

first_slice.note: One multi-scenario smoke test file covering the enumerated flows; runnable under make smoke.

success.note: Enumerated scenarios green in the gate; verify-lifecycle RequireCoverage passes over the generated histories; no existing smoke regression.

context_memo.note: Baked now: seams smoke/checkout_test.go + store smoke suites; governing ADR-025 (occurrence semantics being exercised), ADR-021 (verify-lifecycle), TKT-93 relative-time-fixture learning.

binding.rule: Occurrence id is an idempotency key; replay returns a distinguishable replay result, never a bare accepted.

governingAdrs.why: The semantics every scenario exercises (replay, duplicate_admit scoping, reconciliation ordering).
verify-lifecycle RequireCoverage is the closing assertion over generated histories.

reference.summary: Gateway smoke seams: smoke/checkout_test.go (scan/reconcile drivers), scripts/smoke.sh (stack)
TKT-93 learning: time-window fixtures relative to now, never fixed dates
TKT-87 pass flows to cover: direction field, exit_required/not_inside, derived-conflict raise->withdraw
